rationale: The PUDL/EIA-930 regional demand series were not present in the (truncated) catalogue, so Henry Hub gas returns (Gulf-Coast generation-fuel demand proxy) stand in for Texas demand deviations, paired with Houston ground-sensor PM2.5 as a same-calendar-week anomaly over the 2026 war window with a short lag; confounders include weather/seasonality driving both, small n, and the war as a common shock.
